clips.title: The story
paras: At Stonewrought Dam, Disarming Mixture is prepared to stop a Seaforium charge from breaking the dam. Chief Engineer Hinderweir makes it to neutralize explosives planted by Dark Iron saboteurs.

Dark Iron saboteurs planted a heavy Seaforium charge beneath Stonewrought Dam’s foundation. With no Mountaineer support close at hand, Chief Engineer Hinderweir used ingredients named by explosives expert Ashlan Stonesmirk to make the Disarming Mixture. Stirred into the planted powder keg underwater, the solution neutralizes its reactive compounds and leaves the charge fizzled and harmless.
